page.overview:
Who is Bobby Swift?

Bobby Swift is a secondary character in Cars 3. Along with Cal Weathers, he is close friends with Lightning McQueen. He races for Octane Gain and is number 19.

Bobby appears during the introductory scene with his two friends, Lightning McQueen and Cal Weathers. He participates in the pranks of his classmates but is never seen being the victim of a prank. During a race, he is passed by Jackson Storm, whom he seemed to know by reputation.

As rookies take over the tracks, veterans like Bobby end up being replaced or removed. During the season, Bobby gets replaced by a next-gen racer named Daniel Swervez.
